open.why: The Figma draft's space/2xs to 3xl (2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48px) is a second scale; D01 and D14 decide one 3px system. Not admitted. The draft's buttons and chip are bound to it.
metric 5, 7, 10, 14 and 20, the tooltip's 10, 11 and 13, the alert's 10 and 16, and the question inset 19 are decided or measured values off the 3px grid. Whether each stays off-grid is undecided.
Decided as a 1px neutral hairline, but its recorded colour is not in the product palette.
On the palette image, not in the palette record. Awaiting Daniel's call.
Used by the chat app, not in the palette record. Awaiting Daniel's call.
Colour, width, offset and keyboard state are undecided. The sharp action-blue outline is rejected.
Sizes, lines and weights after the font swap are undecided.
No product matrix. The brand z-index table and the 44px icon target are brand scope; product adoption is unverified.
Brand-scope decisions only; product adoption is unverified.
Button and chip press, release and focus timings, and the shared panel slide, are undecided.
Recorded as a deceleration; the curve was not.
The palette defines a separate hover role. Chat uses the resting role on hover. Product interaction routing awaits review.
Use the landing entrance on new conversation. Its five-part study is the reference. Individual timings and their assignment to product elements await confirmation.
The 4px category/status radius is a formal brand decision. Product adoption is undecided.
Confirm whether a structural zero belongs beside the ten approved positive steps.

rules: Raw values live only in this file. Every other file references tokens.
Keep the default slashed zero on every surface; never enable the font's plain-zero feature (D68).
Density is chosen explicitly; width never selects it (D03, D45).
A parent owns sibling gaps, a field owns its interior, the host owns viewport position (D13).
